free_text.text: Staggered treatment 1992-2009
Linear trends by 2-digit sector
Dynamic effects: 12 leads/lags
Placebo tests: 4 lags
Robust SE clustered at firm
Balanced panel 1992-2009; positive employment; complete reporting

Simulated PROWESS data; core pipeline: 3 cleaning scripts, first stage, 4 main outcomes, heterogeneity by baseline dividends/capital, appendix robustness checks. Main estimator: did_multiplegt with staggered adoption, 12-lag dynamic effects, sector trends, robust SE clustered at firm level.
DID event study of SLL issuance on ESG reference score; propensity score matched sample; ±3 years sample window.

Master pipeline (make.R) sources 4 main analysis files in parallel. Focused on table1_heat_rate.R as primary specification example; other scripts follow similar event-study patterns with different outcomes.
Conditional logic on id variable: replace name_en based on id values
Treatment and control variables interact with famine indicator (famine=1 if year==1932)
Outcome variable is forward difference: fmortality = f.mortality (captures 1933 outcome from 1932 covariates)

Province and district-level data construction scripts read. Main tables and figures scripts fully read. Appendix robustness scripts skipped due to budget. Both v2 and v3 replication packages present; v2 analyzed.

Read master script, 9 main table scripts, event study figure, and IV appendix spec. Skipped data prep (150 lines each), appendix tables/figures, and R scripts due to budget. Primary methods: DID and event_study with reghdfe for sample pooling analyses; individual cohort-level DID for survey data. IV specs present in appendix (tableA22) instrument for intermediate school entry using geographic variation in waqf and rice productivity.
Global variables for control specifications ($Tradecontrols, $PolicyControls, $NeighbourControls, $LogControls) used across all did_imputation specifications

Focus on main analysis Part1Analysis1.do (Tables 1-7, Figures 4-5, 7, A4). Part1Process.do shows data pipeline (9 steps); specific data cleaning scripts listed but not deep-read per policy. Part2Analysis.do covers financial market outcomes (Table 4). Part3Analysis.ipynb produces map visualizations (Figures 1b, A3).
parallel trends assumption may be violated
Use createSensitivityResults_relativeMagnitudes to bound post-treatment violations
Intermediate results stored as RDS objects in Temp/ for sequential loading
Benzarti-Carloni: extracts event study coefficients matching treatment year pattern

Focuses on two economic applications (Benzarti-Carloni, Lovenheim-Willen) and simulation study. Main estimator is event-study OLS with high-dimensional fixed effects via lfe::felm. Core methodology implemented in HonestDiD R package for sensitivity analysis under partial identification.
Event study around Jay Cooke failure (9/18/1873); ppmlhdfe for counts, reghdfe for closures.

notes: Observed practices only. Shares are among papers whose card records a known value; null/unknown/not_found_in_scope are never counted as absence. Recommendations live in recommendations.md and require method sources and review.
